metadata.title: AWS GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring Component Definition

components.title: AWS GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring
components.description: GuardDuty detector with ECS Runtime Monitoring auto-configuration, EventBridge finding routing, SNS alerting. Deployed via AWS/ECS/modules/guardduty/.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls implemented by AWS GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring with EventBridge alerting

implemented-requirements.description: GuardDuty provides continuous runtime monitoring of ECS Fargate containers. Detects crypto mining, container escape, malicious DNS queries, privilege escalation, and unauthorized access patterns. Agent auto-injected by AWS — no task definition changes.
EventBridge rule routes MEDIUM+ severity findings (>= 4.0) to a dedicated SNS topic for email notification. Severity scale: LOW (1-3.9), MEDIUM (4-6.9), HIGH (7-8.9), CRITICAL (9-10).
GuardDuty findings include actionable details (affected resource, threat type, severity, recommended remediation). SNS alerts enable timely incident response.
Findings centralized in GuardDuty console with filtering by severity, resource type, and time range. Integration with Security Hub possible for cross-service correlation.
Runtime monitoring detects malicious network activity from within containers — complements VPC flow logs and security group enforcement.
